e.title: Insurance A2A + MCP (MSFT)
e.summary: 保险理赔 A2A+MCP 智能体平台（12★）：Azure Foundry + 实时语音 + 多智能体编排 + 文档智能
e.body: Insurance A2A + MCP（ujjwalmsft/insuranceA2AMCP，12★）是保险理赔处理的 agentic 平台演示：Azure AI Foundry + Agent-to-Agent（A2A）协议 + MCP——理赔编排器动态路由、实时语音接口（Azure Voice Live API）处理客户理赔状态查询、文档智能核验、承保范围规则引擎、员工仪表盘与邮件通知。对 RIAA：A2A 新一代 agent 协议的保险用例——与 [[claims-intake-agent]]（微软 AF 理赔受理）、[[claims-processing-hack]]（Foundry 黑客松）、[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]（多智能体 MCP）互补；语音+agent 方向是新兴范式。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Azure Foundry A2A+MCP 理赔平台（实时语音+多智能体+文档智能），12★
e.summary_en: Insurance claims A2A+MCP agent platform (12★): Azure Foundry + realtime voice + multi-agent orchestration + document intelligence
e.summary_hk: 保險理賠 A2A+MCP 智能體平台（12★）：Azure Foundry + 實時語音 + 多智能體編排 + 文檔智能
e.body_en: Insurance A2A + MCP (ujjwalmsft/insuranceA2AMCP, 12★) is an agentic platform demo for insurance claims processing: Azure AI Foundry + the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol + MCP — a claims orchestrator with dynamic routing, a real-time voice interface (Azure Voice Live API) for customer claim-status queries, document-intelligence validation, a smart coverage rules engine, an employee dashboard and email notifications. For RIAA: an insurance use case for the new-generation A2A agent protocol — complements [[claims-intake-agent]] (Microsoft AF claims intake), [[claims-processing-hack]] (Foundry hackathon) and [[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]] (multi-agent MCP); the voice+agent direction is an emerging paradigm.
e.body_hk: Insurance A2A + MCP（ujjwalmsft/insuranceA2AMCP，12★）是保險理賠處理的 agentic 平台演示：Azure AI Foundry + Agent-to-Agent（A2A）協議 + MCP——理賠編排器動態路由、實時語音接口（Azure Voice Live API）處理客戶理賠狀態查詢、文檔智能核驗、承保範圍規則引擎、員工儀表盤與電郵通知。對 RIAA：A2A 新一代 agent 協議的保險用例——與 [[claims-intake-agent]]（微軟 AF 理賠受理）、[[claims-processing-hack]]（Foundry 黑客松）、[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]（多智能體 MCP）互補；語音+agent 方向是新興範式。
